title: Differential Survival and Reproduction
text: Natural selection requires: (1) Variation in a trait, (2) The trait must be heritable, (3) The trait must affect survival or reproduction. Consider what happens when only resistant bacteria survive to reproduce.

title: Allele Frequency Changes
text: Evolution is defined as a change in allele frequency in a population over time. If resistant bacteria survive and reproduce while non-resistant bacteria die, what happens to the frequency of the resistance allele in subsequent generations?
